name: erp-workspace
x-entrypoint-note: 根级 package.json scripts 是官方入口；Makefile 与 scripts/accept_*.sh 仅作兼容包装层。

scripts.accept:web: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
scripts.accept:backend: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --all
scripts.release:gate: pnpm run repo:verify && cargo test -p erp-api --test stats_clickhouse_sso_smoke -- --nocapture && pnpm --dir apps/erp-web run generate:api && pnpm --dir apps/erp-web build && pnpm run test:e2e:release-gate
scripts.release:gate:full: pnpm run repo:verify && pnpm run test:backend:release-gate && pnpm --dir apps/erp-web run generate:api && pnpm --dir apps/erp-web build && pnpm run test:e2e:release-gate
